## Math

Inline: $\mathbf{x} \in \mathbb{R}^{d}$ and $p(y \mid x)$.

Numbered equation:

$$
\mathcal{L}(\theta) = -\sum_{i=1}^{N} \log p_\theta(y_i \mid x_i)
$$ {#eq-loss}

See @eq-loss.

Aligned equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}
Q &= X W_Q \\
K &= X W_K \\
V &= X W_V
\end{aligned}
$$

## Interactive: Observable JS

Move the slider to change the softmax temperature.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof temperature = Inputs.range([0.1, 5], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Temperature"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
logits = [2.0, 1.0, 0.1, -1.0]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
probs = {
  const e = logits.map(z => Math.exp(z / temperature));
  const s = e.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  return e.map((v, i) => ({token: `token ${i + 1}`, p: v / s}));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  y: {domain: [0, 1], label: "probability"},
  marks: [Plot.barY(probs, {x: "token", y: "p", fill: "steelblue"}), Plot.ruleY([0])]
})
```

## Interactive: Plotly

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML

x = np.linspace(-3, 3, 61)
fig = go.Figure(go.Scatter(x=x, y=np.tanh(x), mode="lines"))
fig.update_layout(title="Hover over the curve", xaxis_title="x", yaxis_title="tanh(x)")
HTML(fig.to_html(full_html=False, include_plotlyjs="cdn", include_mathjax=False))
```
